title: Let rumdl enforce MD055 and MD056 for doc tables
description:
## What does this MR do?

`rumdl` already enforces MD055 and MD056 in CI, and it accepts the Hugo attribute line (for example, `{.sortable}`) after a table. This MR turns off MD055 and MD056 in `.markdownlint-cli2.yaml`, so `rumdl` is the only linter for them. This project has no `markdownlint-disable MD055 MD056` comments to remove.

This is the same change as https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/267028.

## Related issues

- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/technical-writing/team-tasks/-/work_items/1781
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/636658

## Author's checklist

- [ ] Optional. Consider taking [the GitLab Technical Writing Fundamentals course](https://university.gitlab.com/courses/gitlab-technical-writing-fundamentals).
- [ ] Follow the:
  - [Documentation process](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/workflow/).
  - [Documentation guidelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/).
  - [Style Guide](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/styleguide/).
- [ ] If you're adding or changing the main heading of the page (H1), ensure that the [product availability details](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/styleguide/availability_details/) are added.
- [ ] If you are a GitLab team member, [request a review](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/code_review/#dogfooding-the-reviewers-feature) based on:
  - The documentation page's [metadata](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/metadata/).
  - The [associated Technical Writer](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/marketing/product-and-technical-marketing/technical-writing/#assignments).

If you are a GitLab team member and only adding documentation, do not add any of the following labels:

- `~"frontend"`
- `~"backend"`
- `~"type::bug"`
- `~"database"`

These labels cause the MR to be added to code verification QA issues.

## Reviewer's checklist

Documentation-related MRs should be reviewed by a Technical Writer for a non-blocking review, based on [Documentation Guidelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/) and the [Style Guide](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/styleguide/).

If you aren't sure which tech writer to ask, use [roulette](https://gitlab-org.gitlab.io/gitlab-roulette/?sortKey=stats.avg30&order=-1&hourFormat24=true&visible=maintainer%7Cdocs) or ask in the [#docs](https://gitlab.slack.com/archives/C16HYA2P5) Slack channel.

- [ ] If the content requires it, ensure the information is reviewed by a subject matter expert.
- Technical writer review items:
  - [ ] Ensure docs metadata is present and up-to-date.
  - [ ] Ensure the appropriate [labels](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/workflow/#labels) are added to this MR.
  - [ ] Ensure a release milestone is set.
  - If relevant to this MR, ensure [content topic type](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/documentation/topic_types/) principles are in use, including:
    - [ ] The headings should be something you'd do a Google search for. Instead of `Default behavior`, say something like `Default behavior when you close an issue`.
    - [ ] The headings (other than the page title) should be active. Instead of `Configuring GDK`, say something like `Configure GDK`.
    - [ ] Any task steps should be written as a numbered list.
    - If the content still needs to be edited for topic types, you can create a follow-up issue with the ~"docs-technical-debt" label.
- [ ] Review by assigned maintainer, who can always request/require the above reviews. Maintainer's review can occur before or after a technical writer review.

title: Retry the Pulp artifact race for any checksum type
description:
## What does this MR do?

Makes the pulp upload retry catch Pulp's "artifact already exists" error whichever checksum the error names. Until now it caught the error only when it named `sha256`. In the failed job below it named `sha384`, so the race was not retried.

- The retry pattern now matches `Artifact with sha256|sha384|sha512 checksum of '...' already exists`. Pulp checks those three checksums for uniqueness.
- A new test case uses the exact error text from https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/jobs/17732308701.

## Why was this MR needed?

**The race.** The `ubuntu` and `debian` pulp jobs run at the same time and upload the same debs, each once per release. Pulp stores a file once, as an artifact keyed by its checksums. When two uploads of the same file run at once, both find no artifact, both try to create it, and the second one fails with "Artifact with ... checksum of '...' already exists". That failure is expected: on a retry the Pulp upload task finds the artifact by its sha256 and reuses it, so the retry succeeds. In https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/jobs/17732308701 the race was with the `debian` job of the same pipeline, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/jobs/17732308700, which uploaded the same `gitlab-runner_i386.deb` at the same moment. The retry list in `push.go` has a pattern for exactly this error.

**The bug.** Pulp checks the new artifact against existing ones on sha256, then sha384, then sha512, and names the check that failed. Which one depends on the timing of the race. In the failed job the error named `sha384`:

```
Artifact with sha384 checksum of '2282cbfe…' already exists.
```

The pattern only matched the text `sha256`, so this error counted as permanent. The upload failed with no retry, the push stopped all other uploads, and nothing was published. In https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/jobs/17732308701 that skipped the remaining 47 uploads.

**Why releases mostly pass.** The race needs the `ubuntu` and `debian` jobs to upload the same file within seconds of each other. Usually they do not, and nothing fails. The 19.5 releases passed for that reason. When they do overlap, the job fails, as on `main` on 2026-11-04. Every branch with this pattern can hit it, including the 19.6 release.

## What's the best way to test this MR?

`GOWORK=off go test ./magefiles/pulp/`

The new case fails on `main` and passes with this change.

## What are the relevant issue numbers?

Closes https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/work_items/40256

Related to https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/work_items/40242

The backports https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/merge_requests/7802 and https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/merge_requests/7803 copy the same pattern.

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>getsentry/sentry-go (github.com/getsentry/sentry-go)</summary>

### [`v0.50.0`](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/releases/tag/v0.50.0): 0.50.0

[Compare Source](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/compare/v0.49.0...v0.50.0)

##### Breaking Changes 🛠

- adds NoopClient implementation. The SDK now returns a non-nil noop client and handles the previous nil checks with checking for a disabled client. Code paths that were using nil checks now need to check for `client.IsEnabled`. by [@​giortzisg](https://github.com/giortzisg) in [#​1365](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1365)

##### New Features ✨

##### Crons

- Add `sentry.WithMonitor` and `Hub.WithMonitor` to wrap a job in cron check-ins and create or update the monitor from code. by [@​wedamija](https://github.com/wedamija) in [#​1443](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1443)
- Add `sentrycron.AddFunc` to report robfig/cron jobs to Sentry Crons, using the job's spec as the monitor schedule. by [@​wedamija](https://github.com/wedamija) in [#​1443](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1443)
- Docs: [getsentry/sentry-docs#19778](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-docs/pull/19778) by [@​wedamija](https://github.com/wedamija) in [#​1443](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1443)

##### Bug Fixes 🐛

- (dsn) Build envelope URL without re-parsing by [@​giortzisg](https://github.com/giortzisg) in [#​1436](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1436)
- (httpclient) Decouple span creation from trace propagation by [@​giortzisg](https://github.com/giortzisg) in [#​1421](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1421)
- (slog) Stop replaceAttrs from mutating the handler's grouped attrs by [@​breken-ai](https://github.com/breken-ai) in [#​1439](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1439)
- (zerolog) Unescape JSON string values before sending to Sentry by [@​breken-ai](https://github.com/breken-ai) in [#​1440](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1440)
- Guard concurrent flushes by [@​giortzisg](https://github.com/giortzisg) in [#​1449](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1449)
- Keep http.Hijacker when wrapping a response writer by [@​knQzx](https://github.com/knQzx) in [#​1387](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go/pull/1387)

##### Internal Changes 🔧
